info.title: The readout rate a panel redraws its moving values at

READOUT_RATE_HZ.description: How often a panel redraws a moving value, a readout: 50 Hz, one value every 20 ms, the rate a host sends a moving meter at. A display reads it as its redraw rate; omx-dsp's ballistics keep their own item.
READOUT_RATE_HZ.x-why: The display redraw rate is a panel's word, not a standard one: it left omx-contract (sorting pass row V22, owner ruling 2026-11-20), and its domain is named after its prefix (R-P).
